metadata.title: Arm Insiders Sold $25.6 Million in Stock. They Missed a Historic Rally.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Arm Insiders Sold $25.6 Million in Stock. They Missed a Historic Rally.
Arm Holdings executives sold close to $26 million worth of stock between mid-May and early June, missing the rally that would take shares to a record high.
